description: ERCOT day-ahead ancillary service clearing prices (MCPC, $/MW per hour) for Regulation Up, Regulation Down, Responsive Reserve (RRS), ERCOT Contingency Reserve (ECRS) and Non-Spin: averages, maxima, hours over $10 and $50, a battery stack (best-paid of RegUp/RRS/ECRS each hour, annualized per MW), daily series for the window, and a monthly history back to 2024 that shows how AS prices have collapsed as storage entered. Also a realtime block with 15-minute real-time clearing prices since RTC+B (2025-12-05): average, maximum and intervals over $10/$50/$100 per service, a real-time battery stack, and scarcity intervals where ERCOT's reliability deployment price adder was above zero. System-wide, not nodal. Use when someone asks what ancillary services pay in ERCOT, how much of a battery's revenue comes from AS versus energy arbitrage, or how RRS/ECRS prices have trended.

days.description: Window in days for stats and the daily series. Default 30. Max 30 free, 365 Pro.

hourly.description: Include every hourly clearing price in the window (Pro, max 31 days).

monthly_history.description: Include monthly averages per service since 2024. Default true.

realtime.description: Include the real-time block: 15-minute real-time clearing prices per service and scarcity (reliability adder) intervals since RTC+B, 2025-12-05. Default true.

name: ancillary_prices
title: ERCOT ancillary service prices
